title: Fundamental Lu–Wenzel conjecture
statement:
Let $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$ and let $B,B_2,\ldots,B_m\in M(n,\mathbb{K})$. Let $B^* $ denote the conjugate transpose, let $\bot$ denote orthogonality for the Frobenius inner product, and let $[A,B]=AB-BA$. Assume that

$$
\operatorname{tr}(B_\alpha B_\beta^*)=0
$$

for every $\alpha\ne\beta$, and

$$
\operatorname{tr}\bigl(B_\alpha[B,B_\beta]\bigr)=0
$$

for all $2\leq\alpha,\beta\leq m$. **Fundamental conjecture of Lu–Wenzel.** Then

$$
\sum_{\alpha=2}^{m}\|[B,B_\alpha]\|^2\leq\left(\max_{2\leq\alpha\leq m}\|B_\alpha\|^2+\sum_{\alpha=2}^{m}\|B_\alpha\|^2\right)\|B\|^2.
$$

The paper calls this the fundamental Lu–Wenzel conjecture and states that the BW inequality, the DDVV inequality, and another Lu–Wenzel conjecture follow from it; its resolution status is not specified.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01085

Status: **open** according to the source (as of February 2024). “They started with the following Conjectures , , and an open Question in the space $M(n, \mathbb{K})$ of $n\times n$ matrices over the field $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$.”
source_name: Jianquan Ge, Fagui Li, Zizhou Tang and Yi Zhou, “A survey on the DDVV-type inequalities”, arXiv:2402.01085 (2024).
